name: Fujimura Madoka
source:
A former Yankee and a headstrong wife. Hates the crooked type. With her family, she is a somewhat feminine wife. She rents the first floor of the building and run a lunchbox shop with her husband.

She has a willing husband, but his cock cums easily and she is left unsatisfied
